items.title: Prime divisors and components of effective Cartier divisors have delta-dimension one less than the ambient space

items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the characterisation of prime divisors and of components of effective Cartier divisors by their delta-dimension at source lines 1592-1607, label lemma-divisor-delta-dimension, whose proof occupies source lines 1609-1630. Part one is a pure unpacking of three definitions, but part two requires a local argument: the irreducible component is replaced by its generic point, an etale neighbourhood is chosen on which the effective Cartier divisor is cut out by a nonzerodivisor, the point is recognised as a generic point of the zero scheme of that nonzerodivisor, and the principal ideal theorem is invoked to conclude that the local ring there has dimension one. Only then does the codimension one characterisation give the statement. The counted statement records neither the neighbourhood nor the appeal to the principal ideal theorem.
